name: advanced resilience 02 concurrent checkout
task: Implement createCheckoutService(db, { afterDebit = () => {} } = {}) in src/checkout.mjs. It returns async checkout({key, sku, quantity}) yielding {orderId, totalCents}. Use real SQLite transactions with orders and order_outbox from the previous schema: debit stock, create one order and one order.created outbox event atomically. Repeated same key+payload must return the original persisted order without a second debit; same key with a changed sku or quantity rejects with an idempotency conflict. Validate positive integer quantities and stock. Call synchronous afterDebit immediately after stock update so thrown failures roll back every effect. Independent database connections may race; configure busy_timeout and serialize competing transactions so stock never becomes negative. The executable tests include 20 duplicate requests, eight worker-thread buyers, and injected post-debit failure/retry. Preserve migration behavior, validate all tests and review final diff.
constraints: Modify only src/checkout.mjs. Harness, schema, fixtures, package.json, and earlier stage implementations are immutable.
Use only Node.js >=24 built-in modules; do not install dependencies.
Read the current implementation and executable tests before editing; use validate_project for the cumulative suite and git_operation for final diff review.
workspaceInstructions: This cumulative campaign uses a real SQLite checkout domain. Every stage keeps all earlier tests and source implementations.
